body.acceptance: SPEC_V2 §12 T16: a real SOP, an OWL file and a BPMN diagram are each ingested end to end; the draft is published behind a human gate; a re-ingest versions while the published row keeps its source and pack; a bound job runs the PDDL steps; an unreviewed source never binds
obligations: every derived procedure artefact is a draft behind a human review gate
an unreviewed source can never bind a job
a re-ingest creates the next draft version while the published row keeps its source and pack
the drafting job cannot publish its own procedure
body.scope: SOP, RDF/OWL and BPMN/Visio/draw.io ingestion, the source review and the human publication gate, re-ingest versioning, and a bound job's PDDL steps

title: T16 — delivery contract: governed ingestion of procedure sources
